id: Viridian City Blimp Service
en: Viridian City Blimp Service
it: Servizio Dirigibile di Smeraldopoli

id: \rViridian Forest is up ahead, be careful!
en: \rViridian Forest is up ahead, be careful!
it: \rPiù avanti c'è il Bosco Smeraldo, stai attento!

id: \rBe careful. An evil group called Team Rocket is around here somewhere.
en: \rBe careful. An evil group called Team Rocket is around here somewhere.
it: \rFai attenzione. Da queste parti si aggira un gruppo di malvagi chiamato Team Rocket.

id: \bScott: Excuse me! Let me introduce myself. My name's Scott. I've been traveling everywhere in search of outstanding Trainers.
en: \bScott: Excuse me! Let me introduce myself. My name's Scott. I've been traveling everywhere in search of outstanding Trainers.
it: \bScott: Scusami! Permettimi di presentarmi. Mi chiamo Scott. Viaggio ovunque in cerca di Allenatori fuori dal comune.

id: \bMore specifically, I'm looking for Pokémon battle experts.
en: \bMore specifically, I'm looking for Pokémon battle experts.
it: \bPer la precisione, cerco esperti di lotte Pokémon.

id: \bAgatha here is a memebr of the Elite Four. If you can beat her I'll invite you to participate in something grand.
en: \bAgatha here is a memebr of the Elite Four. If you can beat her I'll invite you to participate in something grand.
it: \bAgatha qui è un membro dei Superquattro. Se riesci a batterla, ti inviterò a partecipare a qualcosa di grandioso.

id: \bScott: The Battle Frontier is made up of seven strong Trainers across Kanto. Can you beat them all?
en: \bScott: The Battle Frontier is made up of seven strong Trainers across Kanto. Can you beat them all?
it: \bScott: Il Parco Lotta è composto da sette Allenatori fortissimi sparsi per Kanto. Riuscirai a batterli tutti?

id: Viridian Gym
en: Viridian Gym
it: Palestra di Smeraldopoli

id: \bThis gym has been closed for a long time now...
en: \bThis gym has been closed for a long time now...
it: \bQuesta Palestra è chiusa da molto tempo ormai...

id: \rAgatha: Hello there child. I'm acting as the temporary Gym Leader of this Gym.
en: \rAgatha: Hello there child. I'm acting as the temporary Gym Leader of this Gym.
it: \rAgatha: Salve, ragazzino. Faccio da Capopalestra temporanea di questa Palestra.

id: \rSo you want a battle do you? Very well.
en: \rSo you want a battle do you? Very well.
it: \rCosì vuoi lottare, eh? Molto bene.

id: \rAgatha: You battled well. I'm sure you will do well against the permanent Gym Leader.
en: \rAgatha: You battled well. I'm sure you will do well against the permanent Gym Leader.
it: \rAgatha: Hai lottato bene. Sono certa che te la caverai bene anche contro il Capopalestra titolare.

id: \bScott: That was excellent. Kid, come over here.
en: \bScott: That was excellent. Kid, come over here.
it: \bScott: È stato eccellente. Ragazzo, vieni qui.

id: \bYou have potential. A lot of it. I'm going to give you the chance to challenge the Battle Frontier. Here, take this.
en: \bYou have potential. A lot of it. I'm going to give you the chance to challenge the Battle Frontier. Here, take this.
it: \bHai del potenziale. E tanto. Ti darò l'occasione di sfidare il Parco Lotta. Ecco, prendi questo.

id: \bThe Battle Frontier is made up of seven strong Trainers across Kanto. Can you beat them all?
en: \bThe Battle Frontier is made up of seven strong Trainers across Kanto. Can you beat them all?
it: \bIl Parco Lotta è composto da sette Allenatori fortissimi sparsi per Kanto. Riuscirai a batterli tutti?

id: Viridian City\nThe Eternally Green Paradise
en: Viridian City\nThe Eternally Green Paradise
it: Smeraldopoli\nIl paradiso eternamente verde

id: \bIs that a Pikachu? Let me look at it.
en: \bIs that a Pikachu? Let me look at it.
it: \bQuello è un Pikachu? Fammelo vedere.

id: \bHmmm... Yep. It is afraid of high places. Pikachu may cling to you when scared. Take it easy and take it to a safe place. It will back off.
en: \bHmmm... Yep. It is afraid of high places. Pikachu may cling to you when scared. Take it easy and take it to a safe place. It will back off.
it: \bMmm... Sì. Ha paura dei luoghi alti. Quando è spaventato, Pikachu potrebbe aggrapparsi a te. Fai con calma e portalo in un posto sicuro. Si calmerà.

id: \bGary: Good job on beating them \PN. Too bad you're still leagues behind me.
en: \bGary: Good job on beating them \PN. Too bad you're still leagues behind me.
it: \bGary: Bel lavoro a batterli, \PN. Peccato che tu sia ancora anni luce dietro di me.

id: \bSpeaking of leagues, I'm heading to the Pokémon League now.\nCatch you later, \PN.
en: \bSpeaking of leagues, I'm heading to the Pokémon League now.\nCatch you later, \PN.
it: \bA proposito di luce, io adesso vado alla Lega Pokémon.\nCi si vede, \PN.

id: \rTeam Rocket is a group of criminals who steal Pokémon.
en: \rTeam Rocket is a group of criminals who steal Pokémon.
it: \rIl Team Rocket è un gruppo di criminali che rubano Pokémon.

id: \bSo you want to know about Pokémon that used to evolve by trade? Let me break it down for you.
en: \bSo you want to know about Pokémon that used to evolve by trade? Let me break it down for you.
it: \bVuoi sapere dei Pokémon che una volta si evolvevano tramite scambio? Te lo spiego io.

id: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, and Haunter evolve at level 35.
en: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, and Haunter evolve at level 35.
it: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler e Haunter si evolvono al livello 35.

id: \bCome back again if you want to know more.
en: \bCome back again if you want to know more.
it: \bTorna pure se vuoi saperne di più.

id: \bCubone
en: \bCubone
it: \bCubone

id: \bYou want to know about the two kinds of caterpillar Pokémon?
en: \bYou want to know about the two kinds of caterpillar Pokémon?
it: \bVuoi sapere dei due tipi di Pokémon bruco?

id: \bCaterpie has no poison, but Weedle does.
en: \bCaterpie has no poison, but Weedle does.
it: \bCaterpie non è velenoso, Weedle invece sì.

id: \bWatch that your Pokémon aren't stabbed by Weedle's Poison Sting.
en: \bWatch that your Pokémon aren't stabbed by Weedle's Poison Sting.
it: \bAttento che i tuoi Pokémon non vengano punti dal Velenospina di Weedle.

id: \bOh, okay then.
en: \bOh, okay then.
it: \bAh, va bene allora.

id: \rzzz.
en: \rzzz.
it: \rzzz.

id: \rWant to learn Snore?
en: \rWant to learn Snore?
it: \rVuoi imparare Russare?

id: \rThose Poké Balls at your waist! You have Pokémon, don't you?
en: \rThose Poké Balls at your waist! You have Pokémon, don't you?
it: \rQuelle Poké Ball alla cintura! Hai dei Pokémon, vero?

id: \rIt's great that you can carry and use Pokémon anytime, anywhere.
en: \rIt's great that you can carry and use Pokémon anytime, anywhere.
it: \rÈ fantastico poter portare con sé e usare i Pokémon sempre e ovunque.

id: \bThe Gym Leader has come back.
en: \bThe Gym Leader has come back.
it: \bIl Capopalestra è tornato.

id: \bWhat will we do without our Gym?
en: \bWhat will we do without our Gym?
it: \bCome faremo senza la nostra Palestra?

id: \bOur Gym has returned!
en: \bOur Gym has returned!
it: \bLa nostra Palestra è tornata!

id: \bWelcome to Viridian City. Be sure to head to the Pokémon Center to heal your Pokémon.
en: \bWelcome to Viridian City. Be sure to head to the Pokémon Center to heal your Pokémon.
it: \bBenvenuto a Smeraldopoli. Non dimenticare di passare al Centro Pokémon per curare i tuoi Pokémon.
